name: Objective list with status tag
definition: Small labeled two-column list of objectives, each with a pill marking its status (e.g. Committed or Stretch).

demo.how: Each objective sits on its own row with a small status pill in a second column: Committed for what will ship, Stretch for what might, Exploring for what is only being studied. Play adds the rows one at a time, so scope is stated without overclaiming.
